title: pergularia flavescens
intro: Pergularia flavescens, commonly known as Yellow Chariot or Vishnukranthi, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family native to the dry regions of India. It has been used in traditional Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, headache, and sore throat, due to its health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Pergularia flavescens include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a valuable herbal remedy. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
